title: Return and Refund Policy
content: Customers can return any unopened product within 14 days of delivery for a 100% full refund. Defective electronics are eligible for free replacement within 30 days.

title: Shipping and Delivery Charges
content: Standard delivery across Pakistan takes 2 to 4 business days. Shipping is free on orders above 3000 PKR, otherwise a flat fee of 250 PKR applies.

title: AI Scholarship and Course Policy
content: Students who score above 85% in the final capstone project receive an AI Engineering Certificate and a 50% scholarship for advanced cloud deployment labs.

title: Customer Support Escalation Rules
content: Billing disputes above 10,000 PKR require human manager approval before issuing an automated refund.
